long.title: TRUE or FALSE? 12 Animal Facts That Were Never True (Disney Faked One)
long.description:
TRUE or FALSE? 12 animal "facts" everyone believes, and Disney faked one of them for an Oscar. Guess before the 3-second timer, keep score, and drop your score out of 12 in the comments 👇

0:00 Play along
0:23 Lemmings jump off cliffs together?
1:51 Camels store water in their humps?
2:51 Porcupines can shoot their quills?
3:40 Daddy longlegs are the most venomous spiders?
4:40 Owls can turn their heads all the way around?
5:30 Elephants drink through their trunks like a straw?
6:12 Chameleons change color to hide?
7:00 Hippos sweat blood?
7:43 If you touch a baby bird, its mom will abandon it?
8:33 Sloths are lazy?
9:19 Koalas are bears?
10:14 Bees always die after they sting you?
11:05 Scores

Subscribe for Part 3: sharks, goldfish bowls and the alligator in the sewer.
